messages:
sara: Heads-up — CI eval runner leaked raw prompts in build logs during the quantization experiment. Spotted customer PII in job logs. Example snippet I pulled (redacted here):
```
[INFO] Request{id=abc123, tenant=acme, prompt=\"My SSN is 123-45-6789. Please summarize my account.\"}
```
Please don't share that raw file.

mike: Repro'd locally on eval-runner v0.9.1. The debug logger dumps the full Request object before redaction middleware runs. :eyes:

claire: Which CI job/artifact? Need to know where else to look and whether dashboards already pulled it.

sara: jobs/evals/quantize/1750001 -> artifact: eval-output.log. I moved a truncated copy to a secure bucket (s3://redwood-secure/tmp/1750001-trunc.log) and started a purge. Will need an org-wide sweep.

dan: Security action items: rotate any keys that may have been exposed, remove the artifact from public buckets, and run grep for SSN/email patterns across recent eval artifacts. Also we need a plan to stop examples being emitted to stdout/logs.

mike: Patch idea — add a redaction step as the first logger hook. Example quick fix (python pseudocode):
```python
import re
ssn_re = re.compile(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b")
def redact_prompt(req):
    req.prompt = ssn_re.sub('[REDACTED_SSN]', req.prompt)
    req.prompt = re.sub(r"[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+","[REDACTED_EMAIL]", req.prompt)
    return req
# Register redact_prompt in eval-runner logging pipeline before anything prints
```
This should be paired with a no-print policy for Request.__repr__ while in CI.

claire: Also, dashboards must never surface raw examples by default. Add tenant scoping and mask example text in the UI. Only show a hashed preview and require elevated perms to view full text.

sara: Important note: the quantization run also showed a quality regression that our harness flagged — hallucination rate jumped (rouge-based halluc detection): 3.1% -> 7.8% after int8 quant. BUT I also noticed duplicated inputs in the runner which inflated counts. Two separate bugs. We should: upgrade eval-runner to 0.9.2 (fixes duplication and logging), add redaction middleware, add CI log-scan step that fails the job if PII regex matches, and set artifact retention to 30 days encrypted with KMS.

dan: For access controls: require an "eval_viewer" IAM role and map it to an SSO group. Add audit logs for who requested raw examples and for what reason. Also require that any customer prompt included in eval datasets is run with --isolation-mode so examples aren't mixed between tenants.

mike: CI wiring notes — update GH Actions job "eval/ci-run" to emit junit xml and a summary artifact but scrub examples before upload. Add a step: 
```yaml
- name: Scan logs for PII
  run: grep -E "\b[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}\b|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}" eval-output.log && exit 1 || echo 'no pii'
```
Fail fast if there's a hit. Also pin eval-runner to >=0.9.2 in our infra image.

claire: I'll update reporting/dashboard to only show aggregated metrics (accuracy, latency P95, avg tokens, hallucination_rate) and provide a gated "request example" flow that triggers a Jira ticket and requires SSO approval. The dashboard will replace example text with a truncated masked string like "[redacted_example••••]".

sara: I'll open a single PR that: upgrades runner to 0.9.2, adds the redaction hook, wires the CI scan, and changes artifact retention/encryption settings. Assigning @claire for dashboard gating and @dan for the policy doc and audit requirements. I'll also kick off a sweep script to search other artifacts. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy-bot started purge job for artifact jobs/evals/quantize/1750001 — status: in_progress

ops-bot: audit-scan queued across recent eval artifacts (7 days window) — will post results to #eng-security when complete.

dan: One more ask — can we add a small eval-harness CI unit-test that simulates a Request with PII and asserts the logger output does not contain that PII? That prevents regressions.

mike: Yep, will add a pytest unit that captures logs and asserts the redaction token exists. Also adding a small integration test that runs the runner with --isolation-mode to ensure tenant header is respected.

sara: Great. Thanks all — let's not let real customer data be used as test data moving forward. I'll post the PR and follow-up timeline in the thread.
